latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Subtitles Generator.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for automatic AI-generated captions.
- Supports adding multilingual subtitles and burning them directly into videos (output as 1080p MP4).
- Fast processing via remote GPU nodes; typical turnaround is 30–60 seconds.
- Includes credit management, session handling, and status updates during processing.
- Handles common errors (unsupported files, expired tokens, no credits) with user-friendly messaging.
